name: Thaumaturgy (Mastery of the Mortal Shell) — 3 Advanced — Marionette

system.description: By spending a temporary Willpower Trait, winning a Mental versus Physical Challenge, and maintaining visual contact, the thaumaturge seizes total control of a target's physical movements and speech. The thaumaturge must keep the target in sight for the duration and cannot initiate other challenges while puppeteering. The victim retains full awareness that an outside force controls his body, though not his mind. Effects last for a number of turns equal to the Mental Traits spent by the caster.
system.duration: Number of turns equal to Mental Traits spent
